units.source_text: 对岸陡削的半山腰上开满了芭茅的花穗，摇曳起来，泛起耀眼的银白色。

en.t: On the steep slope halfway up the opposite bank, the plumes of silver grass were in full bloom, swaying and flashing with a dazzling silver-white light.

units.source_text: 虽说白得刺眼，可它却又像是在秋空中翱翔的一种变幻无常的透明东西。

en.t: Though the whiteness was almost blinding, it also seemed like something transparent and ever-changing, soaring through the autumn sky.
